name: context_memory
description: Persistent context/memory file at /data/context/context.md. Actions: 'read' (return whole file - DO THIS at the start of a session or whenever household/user context matters), 'append' (add a timestamped bullet, optional section header), 'write' (overwrite entire file with text). Holds recaps of recent chats, user preferences, device facts, ongoing projects.

section.description: optional ## header to add before an appended bullet
